usedFor: Trafft holds appointments and customers, and Conversion Chats messages them when “Appointment Booked” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new booking sends the customer a templated confirmation.

watchOut: The same template on “Appointment Canceled” would send booking wording, so write one template per event.
